steps.cmd: devkit handoff create "Parameterize the /invoices query" -a "no f-string SQL in app.py" -a "tests pass"
steps.display: devkit handoff create "Parameterize the /invoices query" -a "no f-string SQL in app.py" -a "tests pass"

steps.cmd: DEVKIT_AGENT=agent-a devkit handoff claim $(devkit handoff list --status open | grep -o '[0-9a-f]\{6\}' | head -1) | head -1

T=$(devkit handoff list | grep -o '[0-9a-f]\{6\}' | head -1); DEVKIT_AGENT=agent-a devkit handoff check $T 1 && DEVKIT_AGENT=agent-a devkit handoff release $T -m 'query uses ? params now; tests not run yet'
steps.display: DEVKIT_AGENT=agent-a devkit handoff release <id> -m "query uses ? params now; tests not run yet"
